Thin tracks to a time interval

Source: R/tt_thin_time.R
tt_thin_time.Rd

This function keeps, within each track, the largest subset of events such that consecutive kept events are separated by interval (plus or minus tolerance), and removes the other events. Unlike tt_regular_time(), which interpolates new locations on a regular time grid, this keeps a subset of the original events. It is a wrapper around move2utils::mt_thin_time(), which requires the suggested package move2utils (install it with remotes::install_github("move2universe/move2utils")). See event_flag_thin_time() for details, and to flag the events to keep without removing the others.

Usage

tt_thin_time(x, interval, tolerance = NULL, criterion = c("closest", "first"))

Arguments

x

A move2 object.

interval

The target time interval between consecutive kept events, as a units object (e.g. as_units(1, "h")).

tolerance

The accepted deviation from interval, as a units object with time units. Defaults to interval / 10.

criterion

How to choose among subsets with the same number of events: "closest" (the default) keeps the subset whose intervals deviate least from interval in total, "first" keeps the subset that starts earliest.

Value

The move2 object x with only the kept events.

Examples

# keep events 40 minutes apart (events in example_tt are 20 minutes apart)
tt_thin_time(example_tt, interval = as_units(40, "min"))
